fullPassage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of natural hormones. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.

det.korean: (A) contain=함유하다 / avoid=피하다 (B) harmful=해로운 / helpful=이로운 (C) banned=금지된 / allowed=허용된

③ helpful/allowed: '이로운'/'허용된'은 문맥과 반대
④ avoid/helpful: '피하다'/'이로운'은 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 제품이 BPA를 contain(함유)하고, BPA가 harmful(해로움), banned(금지) 논쟁의 흐름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: affect(동사: 영향을 주다) → affected(과거분사). be + p.p. 수동태 구문
det.analysis: affect(동사)를 과거분사 affected로 변환. 'to be negatively affected' = '부정적으로 영향을 받다' — be + p.p. 수동태 구문에서 과거분사가 필요
det.tip: to be negatively _____ → 수동태(be+p.p.) → affected

questions.passage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA through their diet. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of __________. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: baby bottles=젖병 / natural hormones=천연 호르몬 / metal cans=금속캔 / food containers=식품 용기
det.analysis:
① baby bottles: 젖병과 유사한 구조? 부적절
② natural hormones: 구조가 천연 호르몬과 유사해 신체 기능에 악영향 ←정답
③ metal cans: 금속캔과 유사한 구조? 부적절
④ food containers: 식품 용기와 유사한 구조? 부적절
det.tip: structure is similar to that of ___ + bodily functions 악영향 → natural hormones

questions.passage: Many products for sale at local supermarkets contain a chemical called bisphenol A, more commonly known as BPA. BPA can be found in plastics used to make food containers and baby bottles. It is also used to protect the inside of metal food cans. These products can cause people to be exposed to BPA __________. This is because BPA may leak out of these containers and into the food itself. BPA is harmful to the body because its structure is similar to that of natural hormones. This similarity makes it easy for vital bodily functions to be negatively affected. Whether or not BPA should be banned is controversial, but many experts consider it unwise to use products that contain BPA.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: at the store=가게에서 / for the body=몸을 위해 / through their diet=식단을 통해 / by the experts=전문가에 의해
det.analysis:
① at the store: 가게에서 노출? 뒤 문장의 food(식품)와 연결 약함
② for the body: 몸을 위해 노출? 문맥 부적절
③ through their diet: 식단을 통해 BPA에 노출된다, 뒤 문장에서 식품으로 새어 든다 ←정답
④ by the experts: 전문가에 의해 노출? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: BPA may leak into the food(식품으로 새어 듦) → through their diet(식단을 통해)
